answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4430 Country: United Kingdom Title: I would like to now if it is ok to work as a security guard in a supermarket where they sell alcohol my job is to guard alcohol. Question: asslamuallikum I would like to now if it is ok to work as a security guard in a supermarket where they sell alcohol my job is to guard alcohol. Answer ID: 4430 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 879/825=D/1429) In the abovementioned market, if only alcohol is sold and you work there as security guard with no work except it, then this job is not free from karahah (undesirability). Try to find any other proper job and leave this one when you find one. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
